mapper.sql: u.user_id AS "userId",u.lgn_id AS "loginId",u.pswd_hash AS "passwordHash",u.email_addr AS email, u.user_stts_cd AS status,u.rsgn_dt AS "resignationDate",u.pswd_chg_need_yn='Y' AS restricted,u.pswd_chg_at AS "passwordChangedAt", (u.mfa_yn='Y' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.admin_yn='Y' AND r.use_yn='Y')) AS mfa
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.lgn_id=#{loginId} FOR UPDATE OF u
SELECT FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.user_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF u
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.user_info SET lgn_fail_cnt=LEAST(lgn_fail_cnt+1,5), user_stts_cd=CASE WHEN lgn_fail_cnt+1 >=5 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE user_stts_cd END, lock_at=CASE WHEN lgn_fail_cnt+1 >=5 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE lock_at END WHERE user_id=#{id} AND user_stts_cd='ACTIVE'

UPDATE sys.user_info SET pswd_hash=#{hash},pswd_chg_at=#{now},pswd_chg_need_yn='N',lgn_fail_cnt=0,lock_at=NULL, user_stts_cd=CASE WHEN user_stts_cd='LOCKED' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE user_stts_cd END WHERE user_id=#{id}
UPDATE sys.auth_tkn SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{id} AND use_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: t.tkn_id AS "tokenId",t.user_id AS "userId",t.tkn_hash AS hash,t.expir_at AS "expiresAt",t.last_sent_at AS "lastSentAt", t.otp_fail_cnt AS attempts,t.challenge_generation AS generation,t.use_at AS "usedAt",t.revoked_at AS "revokedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.auth_tkn t WHERE t.challenge_id_hash=#{hash} AND t.tkn_ty_cd='MFA' FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sys.auth_tkn t WHERE t.tkn_hash=#{hash} AND t.tkn_ty_cd='RESET' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.auth_tkn SET use_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tkn_id=#{id}
UPDATE sys.auth_tkn SET otp_fail_cnt=LEAST(otp_fail_cnt+1,5),revoked_at=CASE WHEN otp_fail_cnt+1 >=5 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE revoked_at END WHERE tkn_id=#{id}
UPDATE sys.auth_tkn SET last_sent_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tkn_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM sys.acs_hist WHERE acs_ty_cd='AUTH_ATTEMPT' AND obj_desc=#{key} AND created_at > (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')-interval '15 minutes'
